method.pointInPolygon: bbox-filtered, 1-degree province grid; no global polygon union
method.notes: A land sample is assigned when it is inside a province or within the coastline quantization tolerance of a province outline. The tolerance is the band between the 1:50m land mask (0.04 degree simplification) and the 1:10m admin-1 province geometry (0.02 degree simplification); it is reported separately and is not an exemption for unassigned land.
